designationHistory.indexText: The federal government bought refuge easements on Storm Lake in 1934 as a water and wildlife conservation project, reserving the right to impound water and keep a no-hunting area for migratory birds.

sources.name: FWS, Tewaukon National Wildlife Refuge Comprehensive Conservation Plan (2000), "Tewaukon Complex Easement Refuges"

review.by: Accepted on the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service's own record (Library decision)
